about: The only places extended-resume will look. Anything not listed here is never read unless the person adds a folder by name. Paths use ~ for the home folder and %APPDATA% on Windows.

sources.label: Documents folder
sources.why: Where most people keep work documents. Strict: a file is read only if it is positively identified as career material.

sources.label: Desktop
sources.why: Recent working files often sit here. Strict, like Documents.

sources.label: Downloads
sources.why: Resumes, exported reviews and shared docs land here, mixed with a lot of other people's files. Strict.

sources.label: Obsidian vaults
sources.why: Your own notes. Vaults are found from Obsidian's own vault list, wherever they live.

sources.label: Logseq graphs
sources.why: Your own notes and journals (pages/ and journals/ only).

sources.label: Notes folders
sources.why: Plain-text note folders kept in your home folder.

sources.label: Apple Notes
sources.why: Often mixes work and personal life, and macOS asks for permission to read it. You can limit it to named folders.

sources.label: Notion (desktop app cache)
sources.why: Read locally from the Notion desktop app's cache (read-only). Only pages synced to this device are there; a full workspace export zip can be added as a folder instead.

sources.label: OneNote (Windows desktop app)
sources.why: Read through the OneNote desktop app (it must be open). On Mac, use an export or a connector instead.

sources.label: Bear
sources.why: Personal notes app; macOS may ask for permission to read another app's data.

sources.label: iCloud Drive
sources.why: Large personal drive; files that are only in the cloud are listed but not downloaded during scoping.

sources.label: Cloud drives
sources.why: Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox, Box and similar. Each drive can be switched on separately.

sources.label: Connectors attached to your agent
sources.why: Notion, Google Drive or Microsoft 365 connectors, if your agent has them. Searched by title first; pages are fetched only after you approve them.

custom_source.why: A folder you added by name.

never_listed: browser profiles, Mail and Messages stores
system and application folders (Library, AppData, Applications)
